name: Skittering Dark
summary: The Skittering Dark is an abandoned mine and shadowy woodland hollow in western Silverpine Forest. Infested by aggressive giant spiders, the cavern and its surrounding woods are thick with webbing and danger for unwary beasts and travelers.

sections.title: A Webbed Hollow
sections.body: Tucked into the hills just east of the western coast of North Tide's Run, the Skittering Dark was once a working mine. Today, the shafts are completely choked with cobwebs, serving as the sprawling nest of giant spiders. With the shadowy weaver Krethis haunting the exterior, the spiders hunt anything that strays too close.

faq.answer: It is an abandoned mine in western Silverpine Forest that has been entirely overrun by giant spiders. The cavern network and surrounding trees are thick with sticky webbing and predatory arachnids.

faq.q: Who leads the spiders in the mine?
faq.answer: No single ruler of the brood is known. The most feared of the spiders is Krethis Shadowspinner, a rare and dangerous weaver that prowls in and around the mine.

faq.q: Where is the Skittering Dark located?
faq.answer: It sits nestled against the hills in western Silverpine Forest, just east of the shoreline known as North Tide's Run.

angles.text: Horde travelers venturing into Silverpine should take note: the spiders of the Skittering Dark ambush unwary prey that strays from the surrounding woods into their webbed dens.
